Materials and Methods

The primary antibodies used for western blotting were as follows: rabbit polyclonal against TDP-43 (10782-2-AP, 1:1000); rabbit polyclonal against TDP-43 (12892-1-AP, 1:1000); rabbit monoclonal (80001-1-RR, 1:2000); rabbit recombinant (80002-1-RR, 1:2000); mouse monoclonal (MA5-32627, 1:500); and rabbit monoclonal (A19123, 1:1000), all incubated overnight at 4 °C.
